column1: # One row per rule Ward can deny under. The question this file answers is the one the
# owner asked of Ward, Makoto and Keel: does it ACTUALLY fire, and what saw it?
# WITNESS    a session in eval/corpus replayed through the real hook entry point by
#            eval/replay.py, which requires the FIRST fire to name this very row. That
#            requirement is why a session is evidence about its own row rather than
#            evidence that the table fires at all: the table is ordered and
#            first-match-wins, so an earlier row shadowing a later one is invisible to
#            a check that only asks whether something denied in time.
# LABEL      machine-checked: replay is a CI step and exits nonzero if any row's
#            declared session fails to fire it.
